$notYetAppliedOrdinals_note: CORRECTED 2026-09-09 against the canonical project's own applied-migration list. This field previously read [] — that was wrong: 0030 (CEO Notebook) and 0031 (Business Transformation intake) have never been applied, and both migration headers say so, so the registry disagreed with both production and the files it governs. 0048 (barberos), 0049 (transform_audit), 0050 (citext guard semantics forward-repair), 0051 (unknown-is-not-complete) and 0052 (barberos owned_website) were APPLIED to canonical production under CEO approval, each verified by a normalized schema+seed fingerprint identical to the local build. 0052 was applied 2026-09-10; its fingerprint over the four new tables, their constraints, policies, triggers, grants, the nine new functions, both new enums and the permission and capability rows matched local exactly (a0c31416669a57cc0e7a4fd542a7f62d), and the security advisor count was unchanged at 36. 0053 (the public read path for a published page -- the first anon-executable RPC in the platform) was APPLIED 2026-09-10 under CEO approval, fingerprint-identical to local on the first comparison (647ace45300930371f6d68e6b0b0b157), and the `site` edge function was deployed the same day -- the first deployed edge function in this platform. Security advisors went 36 -> 40: two new lints naming only the two intended anon-callable wrappers, each counted under both the anon and the authenticated SECURITY DEFINER lint. See docs/architecture-audit/hlvs-phase-11-2l-production-deployment/. 0054 (the discovery call -- what a shop says it runs, learned on the introductory phone call) was APPLIED 2026-09-11 under CEO approval. Fingerprint over transform_audit.discovery's columns, its four constraints, its policies, its trigger, its grants, the two new functions and the new permission row was identical local and production on the FIRST comparison: f015d345b71fac28f0ae26937a502af1. 0055 (the proposal document) was APPLIED 2026-09-11 under CEO approval. Fingerprint over the table's columns, its six check constraints, its policy, its four triggers, the eight new functions, the grants on all of them, the new enum and the seeded permission rows: aa0fe867d3c7e26a14c9458db7e6a759, identical local and production. It differed on the FIRST comparison in exactly one component -- the RLS policy -- for the SAME reason 0052 did: production renders the policy's citext literal as '...'::citext because `extensions` is on its search_path, while the local mirror renders '...'::extensions.citext. Same type, different printing; the fingerprint query now normalizes it in policy expressions as well as in function sources and argument lists. Beyond the schema comparison the honesty trigger was exercised AGAINST PRODUCTION and refused all four cases with the exact expected messages -- a deferred module, a planned module claimed as deliverable today, a module not in the catalog, and a document with no offer array -- leaving 0 rows behind. Security advisors unchanged at 40, the same 40 as before, none in transform_audit: the six new SECURITY DEFINER functions live in a schema that is not in the exposed API allow-list.
